diffs.diff: irradiance (uW/cm2), clear channel at 524nm, raw = output frequency in Hz: datasheet reading gives 0.002591 per count, the part's model has none
diffs.evidence: The second reading's 0.002591 is just 1/386 from the datasheet's typical clear-channel responsivity of 386 Hz/(uW/cm2), which holds only at the 524 nm test LED, at 100 % scaling (the table is headed 'Operating Characteristics at VDD = 5V') and only in the low range ('Irradiance responsivity Re is characterized over the range from zero to 5kHz'), so it is not a general conversion; the model correctly exposes the raw OUT frequency (sim unit kHz, driver returns Hz at a selectable 2/20/100 % scale) as the datasheet defines it, with no irradiance claim to contradict.
